**Karl's Daily Briefing — June 1, 2026**

Yesterday painted a clear picture of accumulated stress. With just 5.6 hours of sleep and no training activities, your body was still working overtime—2,386 calories burned suggests high metabolic demand. The 8,953 steps were reasonable, but that shortened sleep window was the real culprit behind today's recovery concerns.

Your HRV sits at 92ms, notably below your 98-117 baseline, while your TSB shows -25 (high fatigue exceeding fitness gains). This combination screams incomplete recovery. However, your resting heart rate remains steady at 50bpm and stress registered only 27/100, so you're not completely buried—just running on fumes right now.

Today demands patience. With only week 3 of your 20-week build and 132 days until Chester, there's zero rush to push through compromised recovery. If you had a run planned, convert it to a gentle 20-30 minute walk or skip entirely. Your aerobic base won't disappear from one rest day, but poor recovery habits compound quickly.

This is where champions separate themselves—not by grinding through every session, but by reading their body's signals intelligently. Chase 8+ hours of sleep tonight, hydrate well, and trust that tomorrow's data will reward your discipline. Recovery is training, Karl.
